title: Gmail Confidential Mode Cannot Stop THIS #Shorts
description:
Confidential Mode adds Gmail restrictions, but screenshots and camera photos can still capture your message. Understand the limit before sending private information.

Original diagrams and synthetic English narration; not a real account or software screen capture. Official source: https://support.google.com/mail/answer/7674059 #FlowMinuteLab #TechTips

scenes.title: CONFIDENTIAL IS NOT SECRET
scenes.narration: Gmail Confidential Mode sounds like a lock, but it cannot stop a recipient taking a screenshot.

scenes.title: WHAT THE MODE DISABLES
scenes.narration: Confidential Mode blocks some forward, copy, print, and download options. These restrictions discourage accidental sharing, but cannot prevent a screenshot.

scenes.title: THE SCREENSHOT CATCH
scenes.narration: But Google warns recipients may still photograph the screen or capture it with another device.

scenes.title: EXPIRY IS NOT ERASURE
scenes.narration: You can set an expiration and revoke access. Those controls do not erase photos someone already made.

scenes.title: THE SAFER DECISION
scenes.narration: For truly sensitive information, first ask whether email is the right channel. Never equate a label with guaranteed secrecy.
